blurb: Guests participate in curling activities including private group events with instruction, bonspiels (curling tournaments), and skill development camps. Private events are designed for beginners with certified instructors guiding participants through curling fundamentals. The club hosts various bonspiels and offers memberships with access to leagues and competitions.
extraNote: Booking recommended especially for peak dates, evenings, and weekends · Food can be brought in or catered; club provides food but many groups choose own catering
